name: Marsh Lurker (Moncroak)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
Moncroak CR 4

XP 1,200
N Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 39 (6d10+6); Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.; swim 60 ft.
Melee halberd +10/+5 (1d10+6/×3 plus trip) and slam +5 (1d6+2 plus trip)
Special Attacks powerful charge (slam +11, 2d6+6 plus trip)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 17, Con 13, Int 7, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +6; CMB +11; CMD 21
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +12 (+20 when jumping), Perception +4, Survival +13; Racial Modifiers +21 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Survival
Languages Common
SQ jump

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Jump (Ex)

Always jumps as though with a running start.

Powerful Charge (Ex)

Ignores difficult terrain when charging.

Can jump as part of charge to attack higher creatures.

ABOUT

Moncroak is a peculiar monster, originally laughed at for its muddled appearance. When the first of these creatures defeated a local champion through its unique battle style, the trainers of the Kingdom finally took the marsh lurker seriously. Even now, moncroak remains a staple powerhouse of the monster tournament scene.
